spans.s:
मौल, i. e. मूल + अ, adj.
 1. Proceeding from a root.
 2. Of pure blood, Hit. iii. d. 17.
 3. Descended from those who had lived in a village when it was built,
. Born in the same district (of the same root),

मौलि (akin to मूल), m. and f.
 1. A lock of hair on the crown of the head.
 2. Hair ornamented and braided round the head.
 3. A crown, diadem, Vikr. d. 60; Pañc. 230, 18.
 4. The head,
मौली (akin to मूल), f. The earth.
मौलि + क (scarcely मूल + इक), adj. Chief, best, Utt.
मौलिन्, i. e. मौलि + इन्, adj. Endowed with a diadem,
मौल्य, i. e. मूल + य (cf. मूल्य), n. Price,
